hook_text: A school in Mamelodi feeds over a thousand learners every day. How does the cook make sure every plate has what a body needs?
clip_script: The school kitchen in Mamelodi. Giant pots of pap and rice: carbohydrates for energy. Samp and beans, pilchards, chicken: proteins to grow and repair. A little oil in the pot: fats to store energy and keep us warm. Cabbage, butternut and oranges: vitamins and minerals to keep us healthy. Four nutrient groups, one plate. That's how the menu works.
visual_style: Whiteboard plate split into four labelled parts, each filled with drawn foods from the school menu.
mood: Warm and busy, like a kitchen at lunchtime.
pacing: One nutrient group per pot, then the full plate.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and sort today's supper into nutrient groups.
